summary: Verified SEO/GEO implementation for Intrinsic app. All 4 checks pass: (1) Backend SEO endpoints — /api/sitemap.xml (valid XML, includes services/*, industries/*, about, contact), /api/robots.txt (explicitly allows GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Bingbot, Google-Extended + Sitemap: directive), /api/llms.txt (summary + page list), /api/seo (returns org data, PUT requires auth and succeeds with admin token). (2) Build prerender — 34 route index.html files present across build/services/* (21), build/industries/* (6), and 8 top-level routes; cybersecurity has correct title 'Cybersecurity Services | Intrinsic Technology', canonical https://intrinsicamerica.com/services/cybersecurity, JSON-LD with Service + BreadcrumbList, exactly 1 <h1>; healthcare has 'IT for Healthcare | Intrinsic Technology' and 1 <h1>; home has exactly 1 <h1>. (3) Live preview — homepage loads cleanly, no JS errors; client-side navigation updates <title> and renders unique <h1> per route. (4) Admin login at /admin works with provided credentials and admin workspace loads.

issues: Client-side document.title is 'Cybersecurity Services' (missing ' | Intrinsic Technology' suffix). Prerendered static HTML (what crawlers see) is correct with full suffix, so SEO is unaffected. Cosmetic issue only — SeoContext/head.js should append brand suffix for parity with build output.

action_items: (Optional) Make client-side title include brand suffix to match prerendered titles — e.g., cybersecurity should render as 'Cybersecurity Services | Intrinsic Technology' in the browser tab (currently just 'Cybersecurity Services').
critical_code_review_comments: Prerender script correctly injects per-route title, canonical, JSON-LD (Service + BreadcrumbList) and ensures a single <h1>; noscript block removed from public/index.html as required.
Robots.txt whitelists all required AI crawlers and references the sitemap — good GEO posture.

Minor parity gap: client-side SEO manager does not append the ' | Intrinsic Technology' suffix for some routes (e.g., /services/cybersecurity) while the prerendered HTML does. Crawlers see the correct title; only the browser tab differs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend SEO suite at /app/backend/tests/test_seo_endpoints.py covers sitemap/robots/llms/seo + admin auth + PUT. All 34 prerendered route index.html files exist. Only cosmetic issue: client-side title missing brand suffix on some routes — prerendered HTML (crawler-facing) is correct.
rca of the issue: N/A — all required SEO/GEO fixes are in place.
